headline.text: Four pallets on L1 S2 held after *metal-detector malfunction*; expired ingredient on hold at L2 ML3 pending disposition.

summary: Two active holds across L1 and L2. Metal detector on L1 S2 belt-slip issue caught by QA; CILT completed and equipment back in service. Cracked spatula removed from L2 ML3 before foreign material risk materialized. Multiple quality flags: wrong pouch version caught on L1 S1/S3, label defects on L1 S3, blooming on L3 ML4 bars through 2nd shift (EE stationed at demolder, issue resolved by 1st shift).

holds.title: Four pallets held after metal detector malfunction
holds.summary: Metal detector belt slipping caused timing issue; test cards not falling through gap properly—four pallets from affected window placed on hold pending recheck back to last good verification.
holds.status: On hold pending QA disposition—CILT completed, detector now passing all three cards.

holds.title: Expired chocolate barrels on hold
holds.summary: One barrel of item 10228 dark chocolate pulled from warming cabinet after shift change discovered expiration date passed; pallet split and placed on hold pending Kathleen Gilbert disposition decision.
holds.status: On hold awaiting FSQA decision to use or discard.

food_safety.title: Metal detector belt-slip caused timing fault
food_safety.summary: QA check at L1 S2 discovered metal detector belt slipping, causing test cards to miss rejection gap—line paused for CILT, detector now detects and dumps all three cards.
food_safety.status: Resolved—CILT complete at 06:42, detector verified functional; four pallets from affected window on hold.

food_safety.title: Cracked spatula removed to prevent foreign material
food_safety.summary: Peppermint-mixing spatula found cracked during 2nd shift ML3; operator flagged risk of foreign material, spatula removed from line and disposed of before contamination occurred.
food_safety.status: Resolved—equipment removed and discarded; no product contamination.

quality.title: Label wrinkles and missing best-by dates on jars
quality.summary: L1 S3 labeler producing wrinkled labels with missing best-by date on some jars; line stopped multiple times through 3rd shift for labeler troubleshooting, machine functional by 00:52.
quality.status: Resolved—labeler repaired, operator set up labeler B as backup.

quality.title: Wrong pouch version (V2 instead of V1) in use
quality.summary: QA component check on L1 S1/S3 found production using pouch item 40674-V2 when spec and BoM call for V1; warehouse has V1 inventory, correct version being brought to line.
quality.status: Resolved—correct V1 pouches delivered to line; QA coaching operators on pre-use inspection.

quality.title: Blooming defect on ML4 chocolate bars
quality.summary: L3 ML4 intermittent blooming on shell through 2nd and 3rd shifts; EE stationed at demolder removing affected bars—circuit 1 overheated to 107°F at one point, blooming not observed on 1st shift after overnight temper adjustments.
quality.status: Resolved—no blooming observed on 1st shift; temper unit adjustments holding.

quality.title: Nine pallets require plastic-wrap reinforcement
quality.summary: L1 S2 third-shift pallets had inadequate wrapping that could fail during transport to SV; production assigned operator to rewrap before shipment.

quality.title: Soft caramel losing shape on S4
quality.summary: L1 S4 caramel too soft at 09:03, pieces losing shape; operator making temperature adjustments.
quality.status: Resolved—flow wrap acceptable by 13:22 after temperature correction.

quality.title: One pouch 21 pieces (below 22-piece minimum)
quality.summary: L1 S2 pouch check at 20:50 found one pouch with 21 pieces; additional checks showed 23-piece minimum met—production notified to monitor and adjust.
quality.status: Open—production monitoring, additional pouches within spec.

sanitation.title: Debris and wood on production floor
sanitation.summary: Hervin walked L2 plant, found debris and wood on floor in area needing clearance; coaching given to 2nd shift to clean up after themselves.
sanitation.status: Open—area flagged for cleanup, coaching delivered to shift leads.

opportunities.text: Consider adding metal-detector belt-tension check to S2 startup and mid-shift QA verification—today's slip caused timing fault that required CILT and four-pallet hold.
Review incoming-component inspection procedure for S1/S3 pouches—today V2 was used instead of spec'd V1, caught only during in-line QA check.

Consider visual aid or color coding for ML3 peppermint-area utensils—today's cracked spatula was flagged by operator before FM risk materialized, but proactive replacement criteria would prevent close calls.
Review FIFO enforcement for warming-cabinet staging at ML3—today one expired barrel of 10228 was pulled for use before expiration noticed, now on hold pending disposition.

Consider dewpoint and circuit-temperature trend monitoring on ML4 WDS during shell deposit—today's intermittent blooming correlated with circuit 1 overheating to 107°F and dewpoint dips around 20:30–21:30.
